page.overview:
Who is Cosmo?

Sergeant Cosmo is one of the automata created on Karakuri Island by Dr. Tsukimi. Sergeant Cosmo was first introduced in the cover story of Enel's Great Space Operations.

Cosmo wears a green military outfit and a black hat. Like all automata, he has a bushy brown mustache.

He loved his master, Tsukimi, and was very appreciative of Enel beating the Space Pirates. He seems to be loyal to Enel now.

Despite his robotic build as an automaton, Cosmo was no match for the Space Pirates.
